effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] ＜De-Digivolve 2＞ 2 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash up to 2 cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.)
[All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area, you may play 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [Insectoid] or [Hybrid] trait from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
